import type { AttachmentRef, CapabilityId, ContentBlockJudgment, Modality } from './types.ts';
export declare function isCanonicalMediaType(value: unknown): value is string;
/** S-6: no modality is represented by undefined, never a fifth modality token. */
export declare function modalityOf(mediaType: string): Modality | undefined;
export declare function capabilityIdEquals(a: CapabilityId, b: CapabilityId): boolean;
export declare function attachmentRefEquals(a: AttachmentRef, b: AttachmentRef): boolean;
/** S-26: every named predicate runs over the whole block tree before the remaining Schema test. */
export declare function judgeContentBlock(value: unknown): ContentBlockJudgment;
